items.text: This isn't just any content drop, this is a MAJOR content drop.
We've got a brand-new enemy who attacks you with its very name, a cocktail that oozes pure radiation, a range of new cosmetics and a new epic DLC that will leave you aMAZEd.
CHALLENGES ADDED

Challenges are now available in Hazard Levels! The Fox Hole Arms features a brand new room where you can access a range of challenges and their unlockable luxury rewards. We're kicking things off with 25 hidden challenges with many more coming soon. Check out our roadmap to find out when. We've also added 25 Steam Achievements that reflect the Challenges.
NEW ENEMY - WIZARD

Not to be confused with his non-magical cousin, Papa Gnome. Wizard sports red robes and a magical staff that can transform you into...A GNOME. You'll know when he's around as his name GLOWS above him.
NEW COCKTAIL - R.A.D.S
Harnessing rift radiation, R.A.D.S allows the player to exude a toxic aura that inflicts damage on nearby enemies.
NEW BAR SNACK - STEADY ON NUTS
Steady on Nuts will give you an upgradable boost to your Stamina Regen, which are purchasable in The Fox Hole Arms.
NEW MASK AND SUIT - MALLARD & TARTAN

Introducing a new starter mask and suit. Duck fans rejoice, a new Mallard Duck mask is available amongst the starter mask set. Plus, a beautiful red tartan suit for those wanting to showcase some Celtic flare.
NEW JUKEBOX MUSIC
A new piece of music is available in The Fox Hole Arms' jukebox.
NEW DLC - MYTHS AND LEGENDS MINOTAUR
This just might be our favourite DLC yet. You don't need to be a lover of Greek Myth to respect the wealth of style in this special cosmetic pack.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4847360/Hazard_Levels__Myths__Legends_Minotaur_Bundle/?beta=0"]
ADDITIONAL SMALL UPDATES
Increased base player health to 200 up from 150
Lowered the required amount to fulfill the quota per dimension
Scale of the facility should now be smaller in earlier crawls
You can now aim/zoom in the camera at any point instead of only when holding items

Charging a throw now changes the outline color as well: Thank you for checking out the latest major content drop for Hazard Levels! What's your highlight from this update? Let us know in the comments below or join us over in the Discord where you can stay in touch with the devs and community.
